posts.en:
dsh-plugin-heartbeat is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Interval heartbeat that wakes each root agent itself (followup injection) to proactively report progress, risks or blockers: busy-safe queuing, no stacking, auto-pauses when no human replies, re-arms on the next user message.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-dd9543912adcae183732.html
